title: In-app agent umbrella 2: look sees clips, more image tools, lighter on a local GPU
description: UMBRELLA, Fabio 2026-09-26. STARTS AFTER MPI-817 CLOSES (Fabio: finish the old agent umbrella first, then this one, session to session by handoff). Four parts, phases in plan.md: (1) look sees videos and GIFs through services/cardView.js viewFile() - the orphan from message a082a6a6, no card of its own; (2) MPI-904 agent image tools: plain enlarge, background removal, crop; (3) MPI-913 the agent's local Ollama model holds VRAM while its own generations run; (4) MPI-905 warn under 64K context, Ollama agent context 32K to 64K. Member cards stay on the board until their work lands here.
